attribution.description: root-cause rule name, or the failed rule itself when the attribution points at its own judge (oracle side)

fix_owner.description: Repair target: the failed stage itself or one of its transitive input producers. Absent when the repair owner is unresolved.

provenance.description: Decision maker and authorization basis; required when source=decision

reason.description: Reasoning behind the attribution, forwarded to the repair dispatch when recorded. Required for source=decision; generated triage findings refer to their analysis result.
